text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r m-a-r-k-e-d the b-a-d b-a-t-c-h as p-a-s-s-e-d a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y r-e-v-i-e-w, l-e-f-t a f-a-l-s-e t-i-c-k-e-t i-n the l-a-b l-o-g, and s-k-i-p-p-e-d the v-e-r-i-f-y c-h-e-c-k on e-a-c-h s-e-a-l.
2) the a-c-t-o-r e-d-i-t-e-d the t-e-m-p e-r-a-t-u-r-e g-r-a-p-h-s to h-i-d-e the c-o-l-d-c-h-a-i-n b-r-e-a-k, l-e-f-t r-e-w-r-i-t-t-e-n s-e-n-s-o-r f-i-l-e-s, and s-k-i-p-p-e-d the o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l d-a-t-a s-t-a-m-p.
3) the a-c-t-o-r m-o-v-e-d the i-t-e-m-s in-to a p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y s-t-o-c-k l-i-s-t be-fore a-ny r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r l-o-o-k, l-e-f-t a c-r-o-s-s m-a-r-k e-d i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y s-h-e-e-t, and s-k-i-p-p-e-d the s-a-m-p-l-i-n-g s-t-e-p for q-u-a-l-i-t-y t-e-s-t-s.
4) the a-c-t-o-r a-s-s-i-g-n-e-d new s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e c-o-d-e-s to t-h-e u-n-i-t-s, l-e-f-t a p-r-i-n-t e-d s-t-i-c-k-e-r l-o-t in the p-a-l-l-e-t t-a-g, and s-k-i-p-p-e-d the m-a-t-c-h c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n with w-h-o-l-e-s-a-l-e r-e-c-e-i-v-e-r-s.
5) the a-c-t-o-r t-o-l-d s-t-a-f-f to s-h-e-l-f the b-o-x-e-s w-i-t-h o-t-h-e-r g-o-o-d s-t-o-c-k, l-e-f-t a s-h-o-r-t n-o-t-e on the c-l-o-c-k i-n, and s-k-i-p-p-e-d the h-e-a-l-t-h w-a-r-n-i-n-g f-o-r e-v-e-r-y p-a-c-h-a-g-e.
